purpose: Independent numerical oracle calculated directly from published equations, not outputs supplied by the original authors or the third-party GitHub program.

equations.update_order: Section 3.2 algorithm Steps 1-4: initialize V; U from old V; new V from U; center-change norm stopping

independent_calculation: scipy.spatial.distance.cdist for Euclidean and squared distances; explicit per-row distance-ratio membership formula; numpy.average with U**m weights for centers; scalar first-order convex minimizers independently checked using scipy.optimize.brentq. No dafcm imports.
authorship: Independently calculated test fixture; no verified original-author executable or original-author numerical output is claimed.
parameter_note: Bounds [1.1,4.1], alpha=1 and these initial centers are explicit admissible fixture inputs. They are not universal author defaults. Floor(N/K) sorted distances include the self-distance zero, following literal Section 3.1 pseudocode; random center selection is not involved in this deterministic fixture.
objective_definition: sum_i,k U[i,k]**m[i] * squared_distance(X[i], updated_centers[k]); U is the first update from initial_centers, before any second membership update.
